text: Ahmed drives his car from London to Cambridge.
He leaves London at 0745 and arrives in Cambridge at 1017.
Work out the time, in hours and minutes, that he takes to drive from London to Cambridge.
A quadrilateral has one line of symmetry and no rotational symmetry.
Write down the name of this quadrilateral.
Adilla invests $1200 at a rate of 2.6% per year compound interest.
Calculate the value of her investment at the end of 2 years.
Write the recurring decimal 0 87. as a fraction.
A model of a house is made using a scale of 1 : 30.
The model has a volume of 2400 cm .
Calculate the volume of the actual house.
Give your answer in cubic metres.
Calculate the size of one interior angle of a regular 12-sided polygon.
The cost of one litre of fuel in May 2015 was $0.88 .
This was a decrease of 20% on the cost in May 2014.
Calculate the cost of one litre of fuel in May 2014.
Work out 3 -1 , giving your answer as a mixed number in its lowest terms.
Do not use a calculator and show all the steps of your working.
Give your answer in its simplest form.
